verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs describe an Aleph Agent you can tag in Slack to ask questions, with follow-ups that keep context. The same agent can update existing reports and dashboards or build new ones and save the results. Agent mapping behavior is also configured through 'simple, natural-language prompts', so natural-language operation of core workflows is clearly claimed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, in-depth documentation of which product actions the agent can perform via natural language (e.g., forecasting, integrations, admin), and evidence beyond marketing-page claims.
